highlights: Installable ICS with console, typed actions, approvals and hash-chained audit
Groupware, identity, files and browser document editing integrated and tested in an isolated lab
Proxmox provider verified on a live cluster; deployment engine, wizards, credential vault
Office Unbound Docs own source build, user portal, SSO, chat/meetings and telephony lab prototypes
Lab pre-alpha only: not production supported; security review 4 findings open

summary: Core platform components are integrated and tested in an isolated lab: own source build of Exchange-compatible groupware with single sign-on webmail, Keycloak SSO, file sync and browser document editing, backup/restore drills, chat and video meetings, and an infrastructure control server with monitoring, self-healing and a real Proxmox integration (VM lifecycle verified on a live cluster). Guided deployment wizards, provisioning automation and the credential vault are being integrated.
principles: Zero mandatory third-party licensing cost; no artificial user, mailbox or connection limits (ADR-0007)
Own source builds where vendor packages are restricted (ADR-0008)
A feature is working only when demonstrated by executed tests

phases.name: Control server foundation and core platform proof

items.title: ICS: operator auth with MFA, encrypted vault, tamper-evident audit, approvals, durable jobs
ICS: service-level monitoring, incidents, alerts, signed node agents, bounded auto-remediation
Groupware: own source build of Gromox stack (MAPI/HTTP, EWS, ActiveSync, Autodiscover, IMAP/SMTP, CalDAV/CardDAV, webmail), no user cap
Single user directory: OpenLDAP authoritative for Keycloak SSO, files and groupware
Files: OpenCloud with WebDAV, versions, desktop sync engine (offline, conflicts)
Documents: browser editing via WOPI with verified save/reopen and restart persistence
items.note: Lab uses vendor CODE packages for functional tests only

items.note: Own source build, rebranded, no connection/document caps: 30 concurrent documents and 60 sessions verified; edit/save via WOPI verified
